Fixed laboratory regression suite / 固定實驗回歸測試Internal release gate: 176 cases and 352 raw inflow/outflow histories. The validated envelope is passive overflow-weir and rectangular-orifice routing only; it is not a selectable user mode. Riser, circular-opening/pipe, coefficient-table, and composite-outlet results require independent verification before design use. View release manifest.

Scope: one detention facility with a known inflow. Rainfall-runoff, channel routing, continuous simulation, and multi-pond systems belong to Software II.
